meta.name: antinet-four-color-cards
meta.description: 基于解析后的文档与用户意图，生成四色卡片——事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡，是八官署方法论的核心分析输出。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档内容拆成事实、解释、风险、行动四类卡片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在阅读资料后快速提炼出事实要点、潜在风险与可执行行动。
copy.tagline_en: Turn documents into fact, explanation, risk, and action cards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn reading notes into facts, risks, and next steps.

howto.what: 收到解析后的文档和你的意图后，Claude 会输出四张卡片：蓝卡列事实，绿卡给解释，黄卡标风险，红卡给行动建议，并经留痕保证可回溯。
howto.when: 当你在对话中提供解析后的文档并说明查询目标或意图，Claude 就会用四色卡片框架输出分析。

say.text: 这是我需要的文档，请生成四色卡片。
say.note: Claude 会按蓝、绿、黄、红四张卡输出。

say.text: 把这份研报的风险标成黄卡。
say.note: 黄卡会标出过度声明和不确定性。

say.text: 这份法律文档要什么行动？给我红卡。
say.note: 红卡返回下一步操作建议。

howto.what_en: Given a parsed document and your intent, Claude outputs four cards: blue traceable facts, green explanations, yellow risk flags, red action steps. The set is logged and traceable.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you supply a parsed document together with your query intent; Claude then runs the four-color card analysis pipeline.

say_en.text: Here is the document; generate the four-color cards.
say_en.note: Claude splits the analysis into blue, green, yellow, red cards.

say_en.text: Flag risks in this research report as yellow cards.
say_en.note: The yellow card lists overclaims and uncertainties.

say_en.text: What actions follow from this legal document? Give me red cards.
